_how_to_use: Each job is one block in the 'jobs' list. To add a job, copy a block, change the details, and set 'published' to true.
'closing' is the last day to apply (YYYY-MM-DD). The job disappears from the site automatically after that day. Leave it empty for no closing date.
To remove a job early, set 'published' to false or delete its block.
'apply_form_url' is the link to the application form (for example a Tally or Google Form). Leave it empty and the Apply button opens an email to the company instead.
After editing, run: python build.py   then commit and push. The live site updates in about a minute.

jobs.title: Janitorial Supervisor
jobs.summary: EXAMPLE ONLY. Lead a team of cleaners across residential and commercial sites, making sure every job meets our standards.
responsibilities: Plan daily cleaning schedules and assign staff to sites
Inspect completed work and fix issues on the spot
Keep track of cleaning supplies and equipment
Report to the facility manager on each site's progress
requirements: At least 2 years' experience in cleaning or janitorial work, including supervising others
Good communication in English; Yoruba is a plus
Able to travel between sites in Lekki and Ajah

jobs.title: Facility Maintenance Technician
jobs.summary: EXAMPLE ONLY. Carry out planned maintenance and repairs on the buildings we manage, from plumbing and electrical faults to generator checks.
responsibilities: Carry out routine maintenance on plumbing, electrical and building fittings
Respond to repair requests from estates and offices
Run basic checks on generators and pumps
Keep a record of each job and the materials used
requirements: Trade certificate (e.g. NABTEB) or equivalent experience in electrical or plumbing work
At least 2 years' hands-on maintenance experience
Willing to be on call for emergencies on a rota
